threads.body: This upgrade leaves `model/a2a/spans.yaml:98` with an unresolved parent, so registry checks and generation fail for `a2a.grpc.server`. In v1.45.0, `rpc.grpc.call.server` becomes a refinement, but the pinned Weaver v0.28.0 only searches span definitions when resolving dependency parents. Migrate the A2A refinement to a supported base such as `rpc.call.server`, preserving the gRPC-specific attribute overrides, alongside this dependency update.
